Package arztis.econnector.rest.utilities

Class RestEndpointConstants

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.rest.utilities.RestEndpointConstants
public class RestEndpointConstants
extends java.lang.Object
This class contains constants for REST interface. It contains key names of properties file (resources/elga_ref_client_rest_api.properties). This file contains all REST endpoints, which will be used for different services.
Author:
Anna Jungwirth
